_README: Tier-2 (web) developer resolutions that have been reviewed. Only entries with a developer are applied; entries resolved to null are recorded so the decision is legible and is not re-litigated. Each source carries the sentence establishing the ADDRESS and the sentence naming the DEVELOPER, per the corroboration rules in scraper/ri_developer_web.py.

49 Newport Hotel, LLC.note: Newport Harbor Hotel & Marina. Two independent domains, one local trade press. Listing sites (Yelp, hotelplanner, trivago, AAA) excluded before counting.

sources.address_sentence: The Newport Planning Board granted dimensional variances and a special use permit on Oct. 6 for an extensive renovation of the hotel at 49 America's Cup Ave.
sources.developer_sentence: The hotel owner is Procaccianti Companies; the expansion adds 31 guestrooms and expands the footprint by about 50 percent, taking the room count from 133 to 164.

sources.address_sentence: Centerbrook Envisions Renewed Newport Harbor Hotel (49 America's Cup Avenue, Newport).
sources.developer_sentence: The renovation and expansion was conceived by Centerbrook Architects and real estate investment firm Procaccianti Companies.

20 West Extension, LLC.project_address: 20 West Extension Street, Newport, RI (Waites Wharf)
20 West Extension, LLC.note: Independently confirms one of the three candidates the registry address-cluster at 39 Agar Street could not choose between. Second source is the City of Newport's own memo.

sources.address_sentence: The Newport Planning Board unanimously approved the proposal to redevelop Waites Wharf into a hotel, wedding venue and event space at a special meeting on June 2.
sources.developer_sentence: The proposal comes from Harbour Realty LLC and the Abruzese family, which owns much of the wharf.

sources.address_sentence: Application concerning the properties north of Waites Wharf, including 20 West Extension Street.
sources.developer_sentence: Harbour Realty, LLC as the applicant, and Harbour Realty, LLC and 20 West Extension, LLC as owners, to construct two new structures to the north of Waites Wharf.

525 Broadway LLC.note: LOW CONFIDENCE: the link runs through a named principal rather than the company itself. Project is new-construction workforce housing (38 one-bedroom units), NOT adaptive reuse. A '525 Broadway adaptive reuse' page was rejected as 525 Broadway, NEW YORK.

sources.address_sentence: The Newport Planning Board approved a previously denied housing proposal at 525 Broadway.
sources.developer_sentence: BCM Realty Partners is identified as applicant and owner.

sources.address_sentence: Application for property located at 525 Broadway.
sources.developer_sentence: Conor Melville, principal of 525 Broadway LLC / BCM Realty Partners.

RI Custom Builders, LLC.note: LOW CONFIDENCE: the company's own site trades as 'Rhode Island Custom Builders' while the agenda says 'RI Custom Builders, LLC'. Same town and same trade, but the equivalence is an inference.

sources.address_sentence: Warwick Planning Board June agenda item, 10 Unit PDR Overlay.
sources.developer_sentence: RI Custom Builders, LLC is listed as the applicant.
Rhode Island Custom Builders — residential and custom home builder based in Warwick.

194 Coggeshall Avenue, LLC.reason: Searches surfaced BCM Realty Partners, but for the Coggeshall School conversion on Van Zandt Avenue / Evarts Street -- a different parcel. 194 Coggeshall Avenue is a structure-demolition application. A developer named for another parcel is not evidence about this one.

Champlin Heights II, LLC.reason: No sources found. Closest match was 'Champagne Heights' in South Kingstown -- different name, different municipality. Obscure project; null is the correct answer.
